records.title: Why Is PHI OS Needed?
records.summary: When systems optimize separate local objectives, information can increase while overall direction becomes less clear. PHI OS does not try to decide for people; it gives reality, position, boundaries, pathways, and review a structure in which they can remain connected.

records.title: 为什么需要 PHI OS？
records.summary: 当多个系统分别优化局部目标时，信息可能越来越多，整体方向却越来越模糊。PHI OS 关注的不是替人给出结论，而是让现实、位置、边界、路径和复核能够进入同一套可连续工作的结构。

records.title: Why Does Explaining an Outcome Not Equal Understanding Reality?
records.displayQuestion: Why Does Explaining an Outcome Not Equal Understanding Reality?
records.summary: A fluent explanation may show only how one model restates an outcome. Understanding reality also requires position, history, constraints, alternative explanations, unknowns, and continued review so that narrative completeness is not mistaken for reality itself.

records.title: 为什么解释结果不等于理解现实？
records.displayQuestion: 为什么解释结果不等于理解现实？
records.summary: 一个流畅的解释可能只说明某种模型如何重述结果。理解现实还需要位置、历史、约束、替代解释、未知与持续复核，才能避免把叙述的完整感误认为现实本身。

records.title: Why Must Navigation Begin by Identifying Reality Position?
records.displayQuestion: Why Must Navigation Begin by Identifying Reality Position?
records.summary: Navigation does not begin by choosing an answer; it begins by stating where the journey starts. Reality position is not a label assigned to a person. It is an updateable account of a state within a defined time and evidence boundary.

records.title: 为什么导航必须先辨认现实位置？
records.displayQuestion: 为什么导航必须先辨认现实位置？
records.summary: 导航不是先选择答案，而是先说明从哪里出发。现实位置不是给人贴标签，而是对特定时间和证据范围内的状态进行可更新描述。
